page_title: MAL 0-1 VIL | Mallorca v Villarreal 18/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Javier Llabres (Mallorca) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+3' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+3' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
90+2' Predrag Rajkovic pulls off a great save to deny Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.

89' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
88' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
87' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' 5:12 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
83' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
79' Flag goes up against Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Baena departs the field of play to be replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
77' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ben Brereton Diaz.
77' A cooling break is underway.
76' Quique Setien has decided to make a change. Denis Suarez (Villarreal) replaces Gerard Moreno.
75' A quickly taken corner by Mallorca.
73' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
72' The referee signals a substitution. Javier Llabres (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Omar Mascarell.
72' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Cyle Larin (Mallorca), who smashes a first-time shot well wide of the right post.
71' Alex Baena (Villarreal) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.

71' Predrag Rajkovic was forced into action to thwart Alex Baena (Villarreal). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
70' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
70' Mallorca have a corner.
67' Ramon Terrats will be replaced by Etienne Capoue (Villarreal).
67' Here is a change. Matteo Gabbia is going off and Quique Setien gives the last tactical orders to Raul Albiol (Villarreal).
63' Daniel Rodriguez goes off the pitch and Cyle Larin (Mallorca) comes on.
62' 0 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) and he fired home from close range. The score is 0:1.
62' Now Villarreal have a corner.
60' Flag up against Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
57' Villarreal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
53' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Javier Alberola Rojas due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) and his team.
51' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
46' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
46' Half-time substitution. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is replaced by Samuel Costa.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Javier Aguirre gives a chance to Sergi Darder and Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Javier Alberola Rojas has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' A yellow card for bad language! Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
45+2' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45+1' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is substituted due to injury. Javier Aguirre gives a chance to Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' What was Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
43' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle and it's Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
39' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
39' Alex Baena (Villarreal) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
38' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
36' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
34' The game is interrupted as Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is flagged offside.
32' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
30' Chance! Alex Baena (Villarreal) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
30' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
27' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas signals a foul.
26' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
25' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
22' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
22' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 0:0.
17' The linesman raises his flag. Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) is adjudged offside.

16' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
11' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) tackles a bit over-zealously and Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
7' Some patient build-up play from Villarreal as they look to unlock the defence.
3' Jose Copete (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola Rojas signals a set piece.
2' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
1' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Villarreal will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Javier Alberola Rojas.
